error.BACKUP_SET_NOT_FOUND: No recovery set at {path}: the path does not exist or holds no recovery set (a set is one folder with MANIFEST.sha256 in it). Nothing was read or changed. Check the path; scheduled sets are kept under the installation's state/backups/recovery folder by default.
error.BACKUP_SET_UNREADABLE: This user cannot read the recovery set {path} (permission denied); nothing was changed. As the owner of the set, allow reading (chmod 700 on the folder, chmod 600 on its files), then rerun the same command.
error.BACKUP_PASSPHRASE_REQUIRED: No passphrase was given, so the set was not opened. Type it at the hidden prompt in a terminal or pipe it on standard input (never as an argument), then rerun the same command.
error.BACKUP_MANIFEST_INVALID: The recovery set was modified: its files no longer match its manifest, so it is not used. Nothing was restored or changed; use another set.
